source_of_truth.relationship: This runtime consumes that contract. It does not redefine it. Every identity value below is a restatement that the runtime enforces at execution time, and the runtime tests assert the restatement still equals the source of truth.

artifact.identity_note: A single object, so the file digest is the whole content identity. There is no tree manifest for this artifact and the runtime must not invent one.

decompressed.note: Independently observed decompressed identity. It is a second, distinct identity and is never substituted for the compressed digest.

supported_modes.note: The canonical binding enforced by the academic-assets Helm chart and Terraform module. Exactly one parameter object is exposed, so the AlphaFold 3 model selector cannot match a second model.
The shape used by the retained H100 semantic evidence Jobs, which mounted the whole claim read-only at /opt/fs2/academic. Supported so existing evidence stays reproducible.

permissions.fs_group_reason: fsGroup rewrites the delivered modes to 0660/2775 and would make licensed bytes group writable and broadly readable.

checks: the configured parameter path exists and is a regular file
its size equals the declared size_bytes exactly
its zstd magic equals the declared magic_hex
its SHA-256 equals the declared sha256 exactly
the resolved model directory contains exactly one AlphaFold 3 parameter object
no parameter byte is copied, decompressed to disk, cached or exported outside the read-only mount
runtime_enforcement.deep_check: decompressed SHA-256 and size, streamed without writing plaintext to disk, enabled explicitly and off by default because it reads 1.1 GB
runtime_enforcement.on_failure: exit non-zero before any AlphaFold 3 code that touches parameters is invoked, and never emit the path or any byte of the artifact into logs

observed_reference.note: Retained evidence from the historical semantic image. Treated as an expected-value cross-check, not as evidence for this image.
